info.title: Kagura.Cli
info.description: Kagura: a self-hosted dev-flow assistant. Installs as a global tool: `dotnet tool install -g Kagura.Cli`, then run `kagura run` to launch the local server.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Kagura — local dev-flow assistant. Run `kagura run` to start the server.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show full ASP.NET host logs (otherwise warnings and errors only).

options.name: --no-update-check
options.description: Skip the NuGet update check on startup.

commands.name: open
commands.description: Open the Kagura UI in the default browser, spawning the server if needed.

options.name: --port
options.description: TCP port the Kagura server is (or will be) on.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Diagnose whether the current machine is set up to run Kagura.
